value.rationale: The recently studied global central maximum leaves all fixed-radius angular ordering unresolved. This result exactly classifies every radial cross-section for all regular n-gons, finds the sharp contrast and identifies a delayed first symmetry-breaking harmonic at order n. The facts give a complete structural phase profile on a natural parameter family and are not isolated low-order numerical calculations.
